description: QuickMind is a desktop AI assistant for Windows and macOS that supports dictation, screen-aware commands, meeting notes, and personal memory. It also offers hosted read-only access to a user's QuickMind data for AI apps through its MCP connector, alongside a scoped REST API for session-backed reads.
summary: QuickMind exposes two developer integration surfaces on tryquickmind.com: a REST API at `https://api.tryquickmind.com/api` documented by an OpenAPI spec, and a hosted remote MCP server at `https://api.tryquickmind.com/mcp` using OAuth 2.1 self-onboarding.
